metadata.title: Secure Storage IT Overlay SSPP
metadata.remarks: Applies information technology (IT) environment constraints to secure storage systems used for enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, and institutional services.

import-profile.remarks: This overlay tightens Secure Storage SSPPs for IT environments and SHALL NOT weaken high-assurance requirements.

pattern-bindings.remarks: Applies IT-specific operational and governance constraints across all secure storage capabilities.

system-characteristics.system-description: Enterprise IT storage environments supporting institutional applications and services.

props.name: storage-environment
props.remarks: Identifies this storage as operating in a general enterprise IT context.

props.name: availability-priority
props.remarks: Enterprise IT storage prioritizes availability while preserving security guarantees.

props.name: immutability-scope
props.remarks: Immutability is mandatory for designated data classes, including records and audit data.

props.name: retention-flexibility
props.remarks: Retention may vary by data type but must remain governance-authorized.

system-implementation.remarks: Secure storage in IT environments SHALL favor balance between availability, manageability, and governance while preserving all secure storage invariants.

escalation-requirements.statement: Storage violations or drift impacting enterprise IT services SHALL escalate via Secure Storage Violation & Drift SSPP.

back-matter.remarks: This overlay applies to all enterprise IT storage deployments and MAY be combined with application-specific overlays.
